evidence_boundaries: Schollkopf et al. is an operating FEL commissioning and performance study, not a laser-plasma acceleration result.
Ogawa et al. directly measures secondary D-T neutrons, while radial diffusion and alpha-particle implications are FBURN-assisted proxy inferences.
Saikia et al. directly measures source spectra, while unfolded gamma spectra depend on GEANT4 response and iterative regularization.
Manti et al. uses real beam-target waveforms, but AUC and accuracy are agreement with human morphology labels rather than independent particle truth.
Pahsa reanalyzes prior helium-plasma aluminum data with only three common time points; Figure 3 conflicts with Table 6 and the text for cathode reliability.
No FEL, beam optics, FBURN, GEANT4, unfolding, XGBoost, Weibull or image-analysis calculation was reproduced locally.
